n: Sika AnchorFix Hole Cleaning Brushes Steel

d.t: Sika AnchorFix tool to clean drill holes
d.s: Sika AnchorFix Hole Cleaning Brushes Steel is a brush to clean drill hole sizes of Ø12mm to Ø55mm for Sika AnchorFix applications.
a: Different diameters for all sizes of drill holes
Additional accessories available to extend the handle length
us: Manual drill hole cleaning used in combination with the Sika cleaning pump or compressed air
d.pk: Bag of 1 piece per brush size (Head + extension + handle)

sec.t: Full steel brushes are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix product
The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures. Always refer to packaging.
